summary: Finished slice 2 of revision 1 (R1, A4). README.md gained a focus-streak key-feature bullet and an 'Opt-in Keyboard Focus Streak' section with regular and split examples that links the new guide. documentation/configuration.md gained a 'Focus Streak Defaults' section plus TOC entry, showing how the provider's defaultProps sets focusSheen app-wide and how a single button opts out. Extended the A4 coverage in __tests__/ZestButtonFocusSheen.test.tsx to assert the configuration page (defaultProps, reduced motion, guide link) and the README (focusSheen, dropdownOptions, guide link). Verified the slice-1 artifacts (focusSheen prop, focus-streak CSS, focus-sheen and characterization tests, guide, api/features/examples docs) are present and untouched. All checks run: tsc typecheck, focused jest (32/32), npm run build, and full npm test (26 suites, 332 tests pass).

tests.name: R1: focusSheen is off by default and opts in per button without leaking
R1: focusSheen={false} renders no streak layer
R1: turning focusSheen off at runtime removes the streak layer from a regular button and a split control
R1: a split button opts in with one whole-control layer and no per-segment layer
R1: opting in leaves the accessible name, role and pressed state alone
A4: the API, features and examples pages document focusSheen for regular and split buttons
A4: the configuration page sets focusSheen app-wide through defaultProps and the README links the guide
